system: PRIME SPARTA FANTASY WATCH / SPARTA REPOSITORY

rules.new_rule: Record every material recommendation in the durable decision ledger before outcome grading.
rules.reason: Create a measurable recommendation-to-outcome feedback loop independent of conversational memory.
rules.expected_effect: Improved auditability, calibration, and learning discipline.

rules.new_rule: Grade outcome and process separately using A-F scales; preserve decision-time reasoning without hindsight edits.
rules.expected_effect: Reduce hindsight bias and improve rule updates.

rules.new_rule: Track signal performance and confidence calibration over repeated decisions; do not reweight signals from a single outcome unless a structural defect is exposed.
For Sparta acquisitions, evaluate real-money efficiency using the $1 transaction fee plus FAAB when applicable, including value per FAAB dollar and churn cost.
rules.reason: Sparta transaction economics are real-dollar constrained.
rules.expected_effect: Fewer low-value churn moves and better FAAB discipline.
